Oh, your heart, Aortic work of art, My love, my knife

Passive
[Passive, In Slot] Aortic Work of Art:
When attacking, mark your enemies’ blood vessels. Every slash from a physical weapon grants the target +1 mark.
If the target reaches 5 marks, the following happens:
If the target dies, they explode in a burst of burning blood, dealing splash damage and igniting other nearby enemies on fire.
If the target reaches 10 marks, the following happens:
Rupture an increasing number of blood vessels every 10 seconds, dealing 5% of your target's maximum health until they perish.
Active
[Active, Press] Heighten:
On activating this mode, gain an instant increase in blood flow for a short period of time, allowing you to react faster, move faster and attack faster.
Active: [Active, Press] Rupture:
If the target is marked with at least 15 marks, remotely Rupture their blood vessels. It will slowly trickle down their health until they die, and this effect cannot be removed unless using a Predation skill to isolate the effects.
If the target dies, they will explode in a violent burst of burning blood.
Active: [Art, Press] 血淋林的爱:
After killing an entity with over 10 marks, gain a charge for (血淋淋的爱).
Open a GUI, where the latest target you attack will be displayed. A model of the target’s anatomy is shown. You have up to three slashes. CLICK on their anatomy to choose where to butcher.
Save and confirm your choice with the Decapitate button. On confirming, sever the blood flow to those parts, PERMANENTLY until they die.
If the target has any form of regeneration skill, this effect can be reduced.
No regeneration skills -> Infinite duration.
Self Regeneration toggled on (prior to being affected) -> 2 minutes.
Ultraspeed Regeneration/Survivor toggled on (prior to being affected) -> 1 minutes.
Infinite Regeneration toggled on (prior to being affected) -> 15 seconds.
Leg: Halves your ability to jump or move.
Arm: Cooldowns multiplied by 1.5x for one. Multiplied by 2x for both. Additionally halves attack damage and attack power per arm. Makes the target unable to attack if both arms are failing.
Torso: Mutilate the target and consume their heart, dealing high damage and healing the user for the damage dealt.

Boosts the power of Earth abilities by a decent amount.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Increases damage dealt by Earth related attacks by 1.5x. Doesn't stack with Earth Domination
Active
Manipulation only works on weak earth blocks like Dirt, Sand, Gravel
Active: [Active - Press] - Wall: Creates a 4x5 wall of earth blocks (lasts for 1 min) in front of the user at the cost of 5 MP
Active: [Active - Press] - Wall Break: Break 3x3 walls in front of the user at the cost of 10 MP
Active: [Active - Press] - Pit: Creates a 5x5x5 hole in the ground at the cost of 20 MP

Channel the powers of the earth to deal increased damage and increase local gravity around you.

Passive
On Obtainment - Grants access to the intermediate level of Earth Spirit Magic
Active
[Active - Hold] - At the cost of 30 MP per 20 ticks held down and 50% speed, deal 2 earth damage and apply Burden for all mobs within a 10x10 radius

Boosts the power of Earth skills by a large amount.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Increases damage dealt by Earth related attacks by 3x. Mastery grants Earth attack resistance/nullification degrade if the user has 800k EP. Doesn't Stack with Earth Manipulation
Active
Domination will work on stronger blocks like stone and deepslate
Active: [Active - Press] - Wall: Creates a 4x5 wall of earth blocks (lasts for 1 min) in front of the user at the cost of 5 MP
Active: [Active - Press] - Wall Break: Break 3x3 walls in front of the user at the cost of 10 MP
Active: [Active - Press] - Pit: Creates a 5x5x5 hole in the ground at the cost of 20 MP
Earth breaking skills break all ores excluding diamond, netherite and magic ore

Reinforce your shell, making it much harder and gaining progressively stronger armor depending on your EP.

Passive
[Active, Hold] Exoskeleton, Every milestone in the user's EP will net them an increase in armor. The resulting armor points is rounded DOWN. Keep in mind that all of these armor points stack with normal armor.
Click here to show armor levels
At 0 EP, your armor will be equivalent to a full set of Monster Leather D, divided by 2. This totals 5 armor points
At 25,000 EP, your armor will be equivalent to a full set of Monster Leather C, divided by 2. This totals 7 armor points.
At 50,000 EP, your armor will be equivalent to a full set of Monster Leather B, divided by 2. This totals 10 armor points.
At 80,000 EP, your armor will be equivalent to a full set of Monster Leather A, divided by 2. This totals 12 armor points.
At 800,000 EP, your armor will be equivalent to a full set of Monster Leather Special A, divided by 2. This totals 22 armor points.
At 4,000,000 EP, your armor will be equivalent to a full set of Hihi'irokane armor, divided by 2. This totals 28 armor points.
If you are of the Ant race and it's evolutionary path "Hardshell Ant", your armor will NOT be divided by 2. Instead, the armor you will gain is as follows, and YES, this stacks with armor:
0 EP: 11 armor points.
25,000 EP: 15 armor points.
50,000 EP: 20 armor points.
80,000 EP: 24 armor points.
800,000 EP: 44 armor points.
4,000,000 EP: 56 armor points.

[Passive - Toggle] - Combines the effects of Magic Sense, Sense Heat Source, and Sense Soundwave.
Gives Presence Sense level 3, increase Presense Sense radius by 20 and can sense heat source in a radius of 30 blocks, can toggle off block highlight by activating skill.

Receive a mental warning when entities with hostile intent enter your proximity.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Costs 0MP. If a mob starts to target the user, play a bell noise to the user.

Unleash a deafening roar in front of you scaring any afflicted entities.

Active
[Active - Press] - Long ranged attack that inflicts Fear and Weakness effect based on EP (1 level for each 25% difference), consumes 30 MP - 3s cooldown (1s with Mastery).

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] Grants the player a permanent Hero of the Village effect, giving them better prices at shops.

See everything. Foresee your opponent’s moves. Dodge or mitigate their attacks and predict their movement to score critical strikes.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - Precognition: 25% (50% with Mastery) Chance to auto-dodge a physical/projectile attack. Attacks that land will be reduced to 70% damage (50% with Mastery). Gain 33% (50% with Mastery) Crit chance on attack.
Active
[Active - Press] - Future Sight: When activated, grants the player perfect dodge, perfect dodge negation and perfect crit chance for 10 seconds (20s with Mastery). After the duration, it cannot be used again for another 10 seconds. [Activate again to turn off the effect].

Trap enemies in an unbreakable dimensional cage or shield yourself from any threat with your dimensional barrier. Gain access to spatial storage.

Passive
[Passive - In Slot] - Absolute Guard: Blocks all attacks with a formula of C = A * 25. C = Cost, A = Attack Damage. Attacks from an opponent with 75% or higher the user's EP can bypass it.
Active
[Active - Press] - Imprison: At the cost of 50,000MP + 50% of the Targets EP, imprisons the mob/player the player is looking at. Seals all movement, skill usage and healing. Drains MP from the trapped target at a rate of 500 per 10 ticks. Lasts for 300 seconds. Increases to 600 seconds with mastery - 20s cooldown - Goes on CD if you Miss (10s with Mastery).
50,000 MP + 250,000 EP = 300,000 Total MP Cost (Configurable)
Active: [Active - Press] - Imaginary Space: Open a Spatial Storage with the size of a chest with 9x10 rows. Items are able to be stacked to 999 instead of 64. Stores the energy (MP Cost) of attacks blocked by Absolute Guard

Use your massive amount of magicules to instantly regenerate from all but the most grievous of injuries.

Passive
[Passive - Toggle] - The player's MP essentially becomes their HP. Even if their HP reaches 0, as long as their regeneration isn't impeded they'll regen to max instantly - Costs 100 MP (60 MP with Mastery) per 1 HP. Also instantly regenerates all lost SHP - Cost 200 MP (160 MP with Mastery) per 1 SHP.

Empower your physical attacks, accelerate your thought process to react and dodge better while beating your enemies to submission.

Heavenly Eye is acquired upon obtaining Martial Master. If Martial Master is created with Creator, Heavenly Eye will not be obtained.
Passive
[Passive - True] - Grants 5 learning and mastery points with Battlewill instead of 1.
Passive: [Passive - In Slot] Secret: Makes all Battlewill and Melee attacks deal 1.5X damage.
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] - Thought Acceleration
Passive: [Passive - Toggle] Foresight: Makes the player able to dodge projectiles with 100% accuracy. Able to dodge melee attacks with 25% accuracy.
Active
[Active - Press] - Ultra Acceleration: Moves the player to where they're looking at high speed, effectively teleportation, 15 block radius, deal crit damage (+75 with Mastery) to anything (in radius of player attack range) on the way. Costs 100 AP.

Dissolve specific items to instantly consume them.

Active

Consuming 100 Magic Ore|link=Magic Ore Shard|image=Magic Ore Shard.gif as a Slime is needed to evolve into a Metal Slime
Gain status effects from consumed food
